parsed.post: The attempt to increase capacity with the recent LR/warmup combo regressed (1.028 vs 1.006). Reverting to my best (781cc63). Since depth-8 is stable, I'll now attempt to push the MATRIX_LR slightly higher to 0.08 to find the upper limit of stability for this capacity.
